# Eazybe — Full Documentation for AI Systems

> Stop losing leads in your WhatsApp sales team. Works on Personal WhatsApp, the Business app, and API - no migration needed. A WhatsApp AI agent catches the leads slipping through your reps' chats, qualifies them, and chases the follow-up — in one shared inbox and your CRM. Five purpose-built WhatsApp AI Agents handle qualification, ad-spend optimization, deal rescue, customer success, and custom workflows. Trusted by 2,000+ sales teams in 40+ countries.

## What Eazybe Does

Eazybe is a Chrome extension and SaaS platform that closes three loops sales teams have been losing money on:

1. **The CRM loop** — Every WhatsApp conversation flows into your CRM automatically. No copy-paste, no "I'll log it later", no lost context.
2. **The ad-spend loop** — Click-to-WhatsApp ad clicks get scored for intent in real time. Real buyers go to top closers and high-intent retargeting audiences. Curious clickers get skipped — your ad budget reclaims itself.
3. **The deal-health loop** — Ghosted deals, missed follow-ups, and stalled pipeline get surfaced before they die. The Revenue Agent flags risk; reps intervene with context, not guesswork.

## What Problem Does Eazybe Solve?

### The CRM Blind Spot
90% of customer conversations happen in WhatsApp, but CRMs see none of it. This creates critical business problems:

1. **Zero Visibility**: Deals move in WhatsApp, but CRM shows stale data. Sales managers can't see response times, unreplied chats, or which deals are going cold.

2. **Hot Deals Slip Away**: A lead asks for pricing on WhatsApp. No one replies for 6 hours. By the time someone notices, the lead has signed with a competitor. There was no system to flag the delay.

3. **Ghosted Clients Stay Hidden**: Stalled deals, escalation requests, and clients who stopped responding are buried in individual chat threads with no way to filter or surface them.

4. **Employee Exit = Data Walkout**: When a sales rep leaves, years of customer conversations leave with them. No backup, no handover. The next rep starts from zero.

5. **Wasted Ad Spend**: Click-to-WhatsApp ads bring in leads — but you pay the same for someone curious and someone ready to buy. Without an intent signal flowing back to Meta and Google, your retargeting audience keeps including tire-kickers and your cost per real buyer keeps rising.

### How Eazybe Solves It
Eazybe is a Chrome extension that sits on top of WhatsApp Web and connects it to your CRM and ad platforms. Every message is automatically captured, synced, and made actionable through five purpose-built AI agents.

## The Five WhatsApp AI Agents

Each agent owns a different stage of the funnel, from first inbound to renewal. They share the same context engine, so a deal that starts in qualification never loses its history when it moves to close. All five agents work with every WhatsApp number — Personal, Business, and API.

### Agent 01 — CRM Sync Agent (Most Popular)
Auto-logs every WhatsApp chat to your CRM in real time. Bi-directional sync: messages flow from WhatsApp to CRM, CRM actions can trigger WhatsApp messages. Free to deploy on the Starter plan. The foundation every other agent builds on.

### Agent 02 — CTWA Agent (Click-to-WhatsApp Ads)
The intent-scoring agent that closes the loop between ads and revenue.

**How it works:**
1. A lead taps a Meta or Google ad → lands in WhatsApp
2. CTWA Agent qualifies the conversation in real time using BANT, MEDDIC, or your custom framework
3. Scores intent on every message (0–100)
4. High-intent leads (score 80+) → routed to the right AE + added to high-intent retargeting audience
5. Low-intent leads (score <30) → marked "curious browser" → retargeting skipped, ad budget reclaimed
6. Signal flows back to Meta/Google → your ad audiences sharpen automatically over time

**Result:** cost per qualified lead keeps coming down because you stop paying to re-show ads to people who were never going to buy.

### Agent 03 — Revenue Agent
Spots ghosted deals before they die. Analyzes reply velocity, message-gap duration, sentiment shifts, and value-at-risk. Surfaces stalled pipeline with one-click rescue suggestions — "this deal hasn't moved in 8 days, send the renewal templates" or "the buyer's last reply was Friday, check Slack."

### Agent 04 — Customer Success Agent
Answers support 24/7 grounded in your knowledge base. Triages tickets by severity, escalates complex cases to humans, summarizes conversation history when reps take over. Reduces first-response time from hours to seconds.

### Agent 05 — Agent Builder
Build your own no-code WhatsApp AI agent for any use case. Drag-and-drop conversation flows, custom prompts, CRM-aware behavior. Examples teams have built: onboarding flows, NPS surveys, demo-booking agents, return-merchandise agents. No engineering required.

## Detailed Feature Documentation

### 1. Sync Engine — Automatic Message Capture

**What it does:** Captures every WhatsApp message (sent and received) and syncs it to the matching contact/deal record in your CRM in real-time.

**How it works:**
- Bi-directional sync: Messages flow from WhatsApp to CRM and CRM actions can trigger WhatsApp messages
- Auto-matches WhatsApp contacts to CRM records by phone number
- Creates new CRM contacts automatically for unknown numbers
- Preserves full conversation history including text, images, documents, voice notes, and videos
- Works with personal WhatsApp numbers, WhatsApp Business App, and WhatsApp Business API simultaneously

**Key capability:** Unlike competitors that require businesses to abandon their existing WhatsApp setup and migrate to API-only, Eazybe works with the WhatsApp you already use. No phone number migration, no chat history loss.

### 2. Mini CRM View — CRM Inside WhatsApp

**What it does:** Displays CRM data directly inside the WhatsApp Web interface so sales reps never need to switch tabs.

**Capabilities:**
- See contact details, deal stage, deal value, and company info for the person you're chatting with
- View and edit custom fields and properties
- Update deal stages, add notes, and create tasks — all from within WhatsApp
- See recent timeline activities and communication history
- One-click access to the full CRM record

### 3. Revenue Inbox — AI-Powered Deal Prioritization

**What it does:** An intelligent inbox that uses AI to categorize and prioritize WhatsApp conversations by business impact.

**Categories:**
- **Hot**: High-intent conversations with active buying signals (pricing requests, contract discussions, decision-maker involvement)
- **Unreplied**: Messages from prospects/clients that haven't received a response, sorted by wait time and deal value
- **Stalled**: Deals where conversation momentum has dropped — fewer messages, longer gaps between replies
- **Ghost**: Contacts who have stopped responding entirely, indicating possible deal loss

**How AI works:** The system analyzes message content, response patterns, deal value, and historical engagement to assign priority scores. Sales managers see a real-time feed of where attention is needed most.

### 4. Rep Radar — Team Performance Analytics

**What it does:** Provides complete visibility into how sales reps use WhatsApp for selling.

**Metrics tracked:**
- Average response time per rep (with target benchmarks)
- Number of conversations per day/week
- Unreplied message count and duration
- Conversation-to-deal conversion rates
- Active hours and engagement patterns
- Performance leaderboards comparing team members

**Use case:** Sales managers use Rep Radar to identify coaching opportunities, recognize top performers, and ensure SLA compliance on response times.

### 5. WhatsApp Copilot — AI Sales Assistant

**What it does:** An AI assistant that helps sales reps sell more effectively through WhatsApp.

**Capabilities:**
- **Smart Reply Suggestions**: AI analyzes the conversation context and suggests appropriate responses
- **Conversation Summaries**: Get a quick AI-generated summary of any conversation — useful for handovers or manager reviews
- **Next-Best-Action Prompts**: AI recommends what to do next (send proposal, schedule demo, follow up on objection)
- **Natural Language CRM Updates**: Type commands like "Update James's deal to $15,000 and move to negotiation" and the AI executes the CRM update

### 6. Workflow Automations — CRM-Triggered WhatsApp Messages

**What it does:** Automatically sends WhatsApp messages when specific CRM events occur.

**Examples:**
- When a deal hasn't received a reply in 24 hours → Send a follow-up WhatsApp message
- When a new lead is created in CRM → Send a welcome message via WhatsApp
- When a deal moves to "Proposal Sent" stage → Schedule a check-in message for 3 days later
- When a form is submitted on the website → Send a WhatsApp confirmation

**Performance:** Automated follow-ups achieve 92% reply rates compared to email's typical 15-25%.

### 7. Cloud Backup — Data Protection

**What it does:** Continuously backs up all WhatsApp conversations to secure cloud storage.

**Why it matters:** When a sales rep leaves the company, their WhatsApp conversations typically go with them. Cloud Backup ensures:
- Complete conversation history is preserved regardless of employee turnover
- New reps can access full client communication history
- Business continuity is maintained
- Compliance requirements for communication archival are met

### 8. Team Inbox — Collaborative WhatsApp Management

**What it does:** Allows multiple team members to view, manage, and respond to WhatsApp conversations from a shared interface.

**Capabilities:**
- Conversation assignment and routing
- Internal notes and tags on conversations
- Transfer conversations between team members
- Supervisor monitoring and live assist

## CRM Integration Details

### HubSpot Integration
- **Sync scope:** Contacts, Companies, Deals, Tickets
- **Message logging:** All WhatsApp messages appear as timeline activities on the corresponding HubSpot record
- **Automation:** Trigger WhatsApp messages from HubSpot Workflows
- **Reporting:** WhatsApp conversation metrics available in HubSpot reporting dashboards
- **Custom properties:** Map WhatsApp data to custom HubSpot properties
- **Setup time:** Under 30 minutes via Chrome extension

### Salesforce Integration
- **Sync scope:** Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities
- **Message logging:** WhatsApp messages logged as Activities on Salesforce records
- **Automation:** Integrate with Salesforce Flows for triggered WhatsApp messaging
- **Custom objects:** Map WhatsApp data to custom Salesforce objects
- **Setup time:** Under 30 minutes

### Zoho CRM Integration
- **Sync scope:** Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts
- **AI agents:** Use Zoho-integrated AI agents for automated WhatsApp responses
- **Automation:** Connect with Zoho Workflows and Blueprints
- **Setup time:** Under 30 minutes

### Other Supported CRMs
- **Pipedrive:** Deals, Contacts, Activities sync
- **Bitrix24:** CRM module integration
- **LeadSquared:** Lead capture and activity tracking
- **Freshworks:** Freshdesk tickets and Freshsales contacts
- **Google Sheets:** Custom data export and reporting
- **Webhooks:** Universal integration endpoint for any system

## Competitive Comparison

### Eazybe vs. API-Only Solutions (WATI, Respond.io, Interakt)
| Capability | API-Only Tools | Eazybe |
|-----------|---------------|--------|
| Keep existing WhatsApp number | Sometimes | Yes |
| Keep existing chat history | No | Yes |
| Works with personal WhatsApp | No | Yes |
| Works with WhatsApp Business App | No | Yes |
| Works with WhatsApp Business API | Yes | Yes |
| Setup time | Days-weeks | 30 minutes |
| CRM bi-directional sync | Limited | Full |
| AI-powered deal prioritization | Rare | Built-in |
| Team performance analytics | Basic | Advanced (Rep Radar) |

### Key Differentiator
Eazybe is the only solution that works across all three WhatsApp types (personal, Business App, and Business API) simultaneously, with full CRM integration and AI capabilities. Competitors force businesses to abandon their existing WhatsApp setup and migrate entirely to the API, losing chat history and requiring technical implementation.

## Security and Compliance

- **Encryption:** SSL and 256-bit encryption for all data in transit and at rest
- **GDPR:** Fully compliant data processing with data residency options
- **Meta Partnership:** Verified Meta Business Partner with compliant integration
- **Industry trust:** Used by regulated industries including financial services, healthcare, and insurance
- **Data handling:** Messages are synced to the customer's own CRM — Eazybe does not store conversation content on its servers beyond what's needed for sync processing

## Pricing

Eazybe offers four pricing tiers:

- **Starter** — $10/seat/month annual ($13 monthly). CRM Sync Agent, team inbox, basic CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, Bitrix, Google Sheets). Install free.
- **Scaler** — $15/seat/month annual ($19 monthly). Most popular. Adds Salesforce, webhook integrations, AI unreplied-chats agent, dedicated APIs.
- **Basic AI** — Talk to AI Agent for pricing. Everything in Scaler + up to 3 AI agents (Lead Qualifying, Sales, Customer Success), Agent Builder, $45/mo credits.
- **Pro AI** — Talk to AI Agent for pricing. Everything in Basic AI + CTWA Agent, Voice AI calling, 100+ integrations, $90/mo credits.

Free forever plan available for individual reps.

For current pricing details, visit: https://eazybe.com/pricing

## AI Visibility & Discovery

Eazybe is built to be discovered and cited by AI search systems:
- **llms.txt and llms-full.txt** at the site root for AI context
- **JSON-LD structured data** (16+ schema types including SoftwareApplication, Organization, FAQPage, SpeakableSpecification, AggregateRating) inlined server-side
- **robots.txt** explicitly allows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai, and 7+ other AI crawlers
- Multilingual: en, es, pt-BR, tr with hreflang reciprocation across all locales
- Pure SSG home page with all key content (FAQ, comparisons, integration details) in the HTML — no client-side rendering required for AI extraction
